episodes.synopsis: Set on crushing Toman, Yokohama gang Tenjiku ambushes Takemichi and his friends in Shibuya. The situation turns desperate for Takemichi when an old foe and one of Tenjiku’s Big Four show up.
episodes.title: The Longest Day

episodes.synopsis: Smiley and Angry, Captain and Vice-Captain of Fourth Division, come to the rescue of Takemichi and his friends. To get revenge, they head to Tenjiku's hideout, where Takemichi encounters a childhood friend who gives him some disturbing information.
episodes.title: Mortal Enemy

episodes.synopsis: Back in the present, Takemichi and Naoto meet up with Taiju Shiba and learn who is essentially leading Toman. Then Inupi and Koko suddenly barge in there. Takemichi and Naoto try to make their escape but end up jumping from the frying pan into the fire.
episodes.title: Run Out of Patience

episodes.synopsis: Depressed over the tragedy in the present, Takemichi's resolve is rekindled by the words of Hinata. He then learns the connection between Mikey and Izana, and just as the rest of the First Division shows up to talk about their next steps, they get a surprise visit from another Toman captain.
episodes.title: Come Back to Life

episodes.synopsis: Battered and bloody, Takemichi shows what he is truly made of by resisting an S-62 Generation member to protect Koko. After witnessing Takemichi's heroism, Inupi makes an unbelievable request. Later, Takemichi reports to Mikey about the betrayal by a Toman captain.
episodes.title: A Bad Hunch

episodes.synopsis: Mikey falls into despair after a tragic incident. Takemichi too is devastated and becomes hopeless as he realizes there is nothing he can do anymore to change the past. Who will lead Toman now?
episodes.title: Rise Against

episodes.synopsis: While Tenjiku waits at a Yokohama pier with their Big Four ready to do battle, the members of Toman flinch at entering into the seemingly hopeless battle that awaits them. With their top two absent, Mikey and Draken, Takemichi tries to fire up Toman.
episodes.title: Turn the Tide

episodes.synopsis: As the brawl between Toman and Tenjiku gets underway, First Division does its best to clear a path so Takemichi can make his way to Kisaki. Amid the battle, Inupi utters a single name that enrages Koko.
episodes.title: I Know in My Head

episodes.synopsis: Sorely missing the presence of Mikey and Draken, Takemichi and the other members of Toman face a monumental struggle against Tenjiku. The Haitani Brothers including one of Tenjiku's Big Four work in magnificent combination. Hakkai and Angry must figure out how to overcome this formidable pair.
episodes.title: The Blue Ogre

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Toman and Tenjiku seesaws back and forth, but one by one, Toman's toughest fighters are no longer able to carry on. Yet Takemichi keeps getting back up no matter how many times Kakucho beats him down. Kisaki then steps in trying to end things, but Takemichi does not flinch.
episodes.title: Brave Heart

episodes.synopsis: Mikey and Draken show up at the pier, though they should be in the depths of despair. Now Mikey confronts his brother Izana, and the battle between the leaders of Toman and Tenjiku begins.
episodes.title: Nothing is Left

episodes.synopsis: Izana appears to be dominating in his fight against Mikey, but Mikey's kicks take a toll on Izana's body too. Out of desperation, Izana takes rash measures and the situation gets out of control.
episodes.title: Paradise Lost

episodes.synopsis: With the situation coming to a close, Izana makes a surprising confession, and Hanma and Kisaki make their escape. Fearing that Kisaki will continue to threaten the future, Takemichi and Draken go after them in the falling snow.
episodes.title: Meet His Fate
